symbols.description: Called in The App Service, it will exit the service and will not affect the foreground page. permission code: `device:os.bg_service`
Get the list of running App services, used to query the service status. permission code: `device:os.bg_service`
Start the specified App service, return the result through the callback function. permission code: `device:os.bg_service`

props.name: file
props.description: The App Service js file must be the one configured in the module app-service in app.json

props.name: param
props.description: Parameters passed in when the js file is loaded by the backend service

props.name: complete_func
props.description: Callback function for the completion of the backend service start

props.name: reload
props.description: Whether to persist and automatically restart following system running state changes. System state changes include: system restart, power saving mode entry/exit, system language changes, Mini Program updates, etc.

props.name: file
props.description: App service js file, same as start incoming parameters

props.name: result
props.description: App service start result, true means success, false means failure

symbols.description: Shutdown the specified backend service, called asynchronously, with the shutdown result returned via a callback function. permission code: `device:os.bg_service`

props.name: file
props.description: The App Service js file must be the one configured in the service module in app.json

props.name: complete_func
props.description: Callback function for the completion of the backend service stop

props.name: file
props.description: App service js file, same as stop incoming parameters

props.name: result
props.description: App service stop result, true means success, false means failure
